description: Aborted the inner out-of-fold weighting idea: the three XGBoost members use the same model on similar features, so their OOF AUROCs should be close and the learned weights near-equal, and a gain would sit well inside the 0.0049 noise.

Replace the radius-2 2048-bit Morgan bit vector with a horizontal concatenation of 1024-bit count Morgan fingerprints at radius 1 and radius 3, leaving the atom-pair and MACCS members and rank averaging unchanged.

Adds a fourth rank-averaged XGBoost member trained on 24 columns (the 10 curated descriptors plus a 12-bin histogram of clipped Gasteiger partial charges over heavy atoms and the positive and negative charge sums).

Swap the XGBClassifier in the three-feature-set rank-averaged ensemble for an ExtraTreesClassifier (800 trees, max_features='sqrt', min_samples_leaf=2, no bootstrap) to test whether ExtraTrees is a better learner than XGBoost on its own, leaving fingerprints() and the rank-averaging unchanged.

Seed-average the three per-feature-set XGBoost members by fitting each with three seeds (seed, seed+1000, seed+2000), averaging their class-1 probabilities, and rank-adding the average to the ensemble; untested runtime at 9 fits per fold, so reduce n_estimators to 400 if the job nears the 10-minute limit.

Replicate the slot-24 ExtraTrees fourth member (500 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 2, fit on the concatenated Morgan, atom-pair and MACCS matrices) unchanged, rank-averaged with unit weight alongside the three XGBoost members.

Abort: this is a near-duplicate of slot 17 (a fourth XGBoost member on the 10 curated descriptors, rank-averaged, scored 0.0920, rejected), and the only change here is coarse max_bin=16 binning, which is a small tweak the notes say to stop.

issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff reads no files and uses no network. It contains no pasted answers. test_smiles only goes through featurize and the fitted transforms, and test labels are never used. QuantileTransformer and StandardScaler are fitted on the training fold only.
No bug that makes the result meaningless. The SVC decision_function output is rank-transformed and added to the ensemble's rank sum, then min-max scaled. That keeps the ordering valid for AUROC.

Minor point that does not affect the result: featurize(train_smiles) and featurize(test_smiles) are now each computed a second time, although the loop above already computes them. This only wastes time. Reusing x_tr and x_te would be cleaner, if they hold the same features.
Minor point: the SVC is deterministic and does not use the seed. That is fine. It counts as one ensemble member, so its weight in the average is 1/(n_models+1).

The numbers check out. The difference is 0.0906 - 0.0864 = 0.0042, and the standard error is 0.0049 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.0060, so z ≈ 0.70. That matches the harness value of 0.698. With one candidate run, a z of 0.70 is not significant, so the provisional reject holds. A replicate run could be justified because the point estimate looks promising.

description: Adds a fourth rank-averaged member: an RBF SVC (C=1.0, gamma='scale') on the 10 curated descriptors, quantile-normalized to normal and standardized on each training fold, scored by decision_function; the three XGBoost members are unchanged.

Replace the XGBoost member on each of the three feature sets (Morgan, atom-pair, MACCS) with an ExtraTreesClassifier (1000 trees, max_features='sqrt', min_samples_leaf=2, bootstrap=False), keeping the rank-sum and min-max ensemble unchanged.
Add a fourth XGBoost member on 2048-bit topological torsion count fingerprints, rank-averaged with equal weight to the other three members.
Seed-average the incumbent three-feature-set XGBoost ensemble over three sub-seeds (seed, seed+1000, seed+2000) to reduce run-to-run variance, with features and hyperparameters unchanged.

Adds an ExtraTreesClassifier (500 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 2) and a random-subspace XGBoost bag (12 models, 200 rounds, depth 4, colsample_bytree 0.15, distinct seeds) on the concatenated fingerprint features, rank-averaged equally with the three existing per-feature-set XGBoost members.

Adds three extra fingerprint feature sets (RDKit ErG reduced-graph, 2048-bit folded Gobbi 2D pharmacophore, 1024-bit Avalon counts) as members of the existing rank-averaged XGBoost ensemble, so their individually near-noise gains can combine.

The job timed out because fingerprints() recomputes every molecule's features (including the slow Gobbi pharmacophore and Avalon fingerprints) on every one of the 15 fit_predict calls; a per-SMILES cache makes each molecule's features compute once per process, with no change to the model.

issues: Integrity: no problems. The diff has no file or network access and no pasted answers. The spline-logistic model is fit only on train_smiles and y, and it only predicts on test_smiles. Its seed comes from the seed argument.

No bug that would invalidate the result. The rank-averaged ensemble and the min-max scaling of predictions within each fold are unchanged from the incumbent. Since AUROC depends only on ranking, the scaling is harmless.

Minor: featurize(train_smiles) and featurize(test_smiles) are computed again for the spline model instead of reusing x_tr and x_te. This wastes runtime, and if the features differ it means two feature paths to maintain. Also, applying SplineTransformer to binary fingerprint columns, if featurize includes them, adds many features that carry no extra information.

Numbers match the claim. The candidate scored 0.0945 against the incumbent's 0.0906, so it is 0.0039 worse. Standard error of the difference: 0.0049*sqrt(1/1+1/2) ≈ 0.0060, giving z ≈ -0.65. This matches the harness's -0.645 within rounding. The gap is not significant and points the wrong way, so rejecting is correct.

description: Adds a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member: a spline-expanded logistic regression (SplineTransformer, StandardScaler, LogisticRegression C=0.5) fitted on the 10 curated physchem descriptors of each training fold, weighted equally with the three XGBoost fingerprint members.

Choose the boosting round count per feature set by early stopping on a stratified 15% inner validation split (AUC, patience 50, cap 2000), then refit each member on all training data with the best iteration scaled by 1/0.85 and rank-average as before.

Enable includeChirality=True in the Morgan generator inside fingerprints() so stereo-specific environments get their own bits, leaving presence bits, the atom-pair and MACCS sets, and the three-member XGBoost ensemble unchanged.

Train each XGBoost ensemble member as an XGBRegressor with reg:logistic on soft targets (0.05 for class 0, 0.95 for class 1) and rank-average its raw predictions, otherwise keeping the incumbent hyperparameters.

Adds a fourth rank-averaged member to the three-feature-set XGBoost ensemble: an ExtraTrees classifier (500 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 2) on the concatenated Morgan, atom-pair and MACCS matrices, averaged over three seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2) before ranking.

Bit-dropout augmentation: each XGBoost member is trained on the original rows plus two copies with 15% of nonzero fingerprint entries zeroed (labels unchanged, 400 trees), and the three members are still rank-averaged.
